window-1.title: The Useless Web
window-1.blurb: One button, zero purpose, and a trapdoor straight into the handmade weird web — press it twice and you'll come out the other side with three new side-quest ideas.

window-2.title: They Call Me… Colette: Beautiful Dreamer (NOWNESS)
window-2.blurb: A punk performance artist who staged her own funeral as art and spent fifty years refusing to be just one person — Mel, this is your patron saint, and the film is as gorgeous and grainy as she deserves.

window-3.title: Negroni Mocktail
window-3.blurb: A bitter, blood-orange-red negroni with zero proof and all the attitude — it's less a drink than a persona you can hold, and it photographs like a dream over one fat ice cube.

window-4.title: Sight Unseen: Inside a Vintage-Filled NYC Home
window-4.blurb: Every lamp and odd little object in this place clearly got hunted down one at a time, which is the only kind of room worth living in — steal the layering and go raid a thrift store.

window-5.title: Visitors, Tanjong Pagar Plaza
window-5.blurb: A brand-new Korean cafe hidden in a weathered 1970s HDB podium block alongside three other tiny indie spots — one coffee, four discoveries, and all that terrazzo-and-tile texture you'd photograph anyway.
